subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

He denied **to help me.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **"deny"** is followed by a gerund (verb + "ing") when indicating refusal of an action.
 
• In the given sentence, the structure "denied to help" is incorrect because "deny" should be followed by "helping."
 
• The correct structure is **"He denied helping me."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He denied helping me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "help to me" – This is incorrect because "to" is unnecessary here and disrupts the sentence structure.
 
• **Option 2:** "for helping me" – This is incorrect as "deny" does not typically pair with "for" in this context.
 
• **Option 4:** "to helping me" – This is incorrect because the preposition "to" is redundant when paired with "helping."
